## Page 4

4Company Development
◼ 1972 Established with 1  MB registered capital to provide motorcycle HP in Bangkok
◼ 1991 Increased registered capital to 70 MB
◼ 1995 Acquired 99.99% of CVA to expand HP business in the Central and Eastern area
◼ 2000 Initiated  motorcycle insurance program to minimize risk which later become sthe industry standard 
◼ 2002 Received award from The Consumer Protection Board
◼ 2003 Acquired CYP to provide automobile HP
Listed on the SET and raised fund of 1,100 MB
◼ 2005 Issued first TK’s Thai Baht -Debenture of 745 MB
◼ 2008 4-Stars Corporate Governance Scoring appraised by Thai Institute of Directors Association (IOD)
◼ 2010 Received  Company Rating A -(Stable) from TRIS                      
◼ 2011 Acquired Cetelem (Thailand) Co., Ltd and changed its name to “TK Debt Services Co., Ltd.”

## Page 5

5Company Development
◼ 2012 Celebrate 40thyear Anniversary
TK is one of the 17 listed companies to receive an “Investors ’ Choice Award ”from Thai Investors Association (TIA)
TK is one of the 9 Thai listed companies to be included in MSCI Small Cap Indices in November 30, 2012
◼ 2013 Total Assets surpassed 10,000 MB for the first time
◼ 2014 First overseas operation in Cambodia, “Suosdey Finance ” in Phnom Penh
Second overseas operation in Laos PDR, “Sabaidee Leasing ” in Vientiane Capital
◼ 2015 Established TK  NGERN TAN JAI with 50 MB registered capital to provide Nano Finance Business
◼ 2016 TK is one of the 12 listed companies to receive an “Investors ’ Choice Award ”from the Thai Investors
Association (TIA) for the eight consecutive years from 2009 to 2016
Expanded two branches in Battambang and Siem Riep, Cambodia through Suosdey Finance PLC.
◼ 2017   Issued TK ’s Thai Baht -Debenture of 1,800 MB, 3 years, Fixed Rate 2.71% per annum.                
Celebrate 45thyear Anniversary, launch “ บิน กิน เที่ยว กับ TK” Free overseas package tour for new customers.
Expanded three branches in Kampong Cham , Svay Rieng , Kampong Speu, Cambodia through Suosdey Finance PLC.
Established a subsidiary “Mingalaba Thitikorn Microfinance Co., Ltd ”  in Myanmar

6Company Development
◼ 2018   Completed the process for disposal of the ordinary shares of the subsidiary “TK Debt Services Co., Ltd”
Expand two branches in Luang Prabang and Savannakhet , Laos through Sabaidee Leasing Co., Ltd .                    
Issued TK’s Thai Baht -Debenture of 600 MB, 3 year, Fixed Rate 2.27% per annum.
◼ 2019   Recieved Microfinance Business License in Myanmar “ Mingalaba Thitikorn Microfinance Co.,Ltd ”
TK is 1 of the 193 listed companies to receive an 5 -Stars Corporate Governance Scoring appraised by

AGM approval of the acquisition and transfer of all shares in Myanmar Finance International Limited  (MFIL )
in Myanmar Received  Company Rating A -(Negative) from TRIS

on the quality of the Annual General Meeting (AGM)  from the Thai Investors Association (TIA)

◼ 2024 TK has consolidated 10 branches operated in 9 Provinces in Quarter 2  and consolidated 15 branches operated
